TOTAL DRAMA: COACHES VS NEW BLOOD
Episode 6 — "Basic Straining"

[SCENE: Green camp — fire pit — night. The fire is low. Four torches where five used to be. The shelter feels bigger without Yul. Quieter. Better.] [Present: Natalia, Manu, Nura, Grett, James, Julia.]

[Julia sits near the fire pit, jabbing at embers with a stick. She's been trying to get the last coal to catch for ten minutes. Her technique is bad. The stick is wrong. She knows it. Nobody else has offered to help because Julia is the kind of person who will fix something herself or die trying. James is in his bunk with his back to the fire — facing the wall, blanket pulled up. He hasn't spoken since they got back from tribal.]

[Natalia and Manu are in the shelter. Grett is sitting on the cabin steps, sharpening her knife on a rock. Nura is at the well, filling jugs.]

[Julia gets the coal to catch. Small flame. She cups her hands around it. Then she looks up at nobody in particular.]

Julia: Is anybody gonna say it or do I have to.

[Silence.]

Julia: The vibe is better. Like, measurably.

Manu: [from the shelter] I wasn't gonna say it.

Julia: Well, I said it. You're welcome.

[Nura comes back with the jugs. She sets them down near the fire and sits. Julia looks at her.]

Julia: You know, in Season 13 I shared a camp with a guy who used to narrate everything he did. Like, out loud. "Now I'm filling the water. Now I'm putting the water down." Three weeks of that.

[Nura's mouth twitches.]

Julia: He narrated his own blindside. "Now I'm being voted out. Now I'm walking down the path."

[Nura laughs. Short, startled — it escapes before she can catch it. She presses her lips together but it's too late.]

[Across the fire, Grett looks up from her knife. Natalia leans out of the shelter. Nobody says anything about the laugh. But everybody clocked it.]

[Confessional: Nura]

Nura: [arms crossed, deadpan] Julia is not funny. I want that on record. She told a story and my face did a thing and that's it. It wasn't a laugh. It was a... facial spasm.

Chris: Previously on Total Drama: Coaches vs New Blood! Three tribes! One jungle! Yul saw the game perfectly, played it terribly, and went home refusing to give anybody — including himself — a second chance. Spencer's been poisoning wells on Blue and nobody knows. Natalia got caught making a fake idol at two AM. And Finn is on Redemption Island talking to crabs.

Chris: Tonight — Chef's boot camp. Fifteen contestants. One bell. Ring it and you're done. This is Total Drama: Coaches vs New Blood!

[SCENE: Green camp — fire pit — morning.] [Present: James, Natalia.]

[James is at the fire pit. He's been there since before sunrise. Not cooking. Not strategizing. Just sitting with his hands on his knees, staring at the dead fire like he's trying to figure out what went wrong by looking at ash.]

[Natalia walks past with firewood. She drops a log on the pile. James doesn't look up.]

Natalia: Hey. You okay?

James: I'm fine.

Natalia: You've been sitting there since—

James: I said I'm fine, Natalia.

[Confessional: James]

James: [leaning forward, rubbing his face] Okay. Here's what I actually think. I came out here to coach. That's the job. [He stares at the camera.] James: The goat thing was easier than this. At least the goat respected me.

[SCENE: Green camp — cabin — morning.] [Present: Manu, Grett.]

[Grett is inventorying the food supply. She's counting cans. Manu sits on the step next to her.]

Manu: You missed a can.

Grett: I didn't miss a can.

[Grett throws the can at him. He catches it. They stare at each other.]

[SCENE: Green camp — well — morning.] [Present: James, Natalia.]

[James and Natalia end up at the same spot. The fight starts over nothing — who was supposed to boil the water, who forgot to bank the fire last night.]

James: I've been coaching this tribe for six episodes and nobody listens. Nobody ACTUALLY listens.

Natalia: Maybe if the coaching was better, people would listen.

[SCENE: Blue camp — tree line — later morning.] [Present: Bowie, Spencer.]

Bowie: Hey. Quick thing. The vote tonight — if we lose — it's Lake. Unanimous. Done by sunset.

[SCENE: Red camp — dock — evening.] [Present: Ara, Aubrey.]

Ara: Can I ask you something real?

Aubrey: Yeah.

[SCENE: Red camp — fire pit — evening.] [Present: Ara, Ren, Aubrey, Gabby, Bruno, Oliwia. Coaches: Millie, Thom.]

[Ara leans over. Kisses Bruno on the mouth. Quick. Over before Bruno finishes his sentence. She sits back. Shrugs.]

Ara: There. Happy?

[SCENE: Red camp — various — next morning.] [Present: Ara, Ren, Aubrey, Gabby, Bruno, Oliwia. Coaches: Millie, Thom.]

[Gabby covers the fire-building for the second time. Then the water run.]

[SCENE: Challenge compound — day.] [Present: Natalia, Manu, Nura, Grett, Lake, Spencer, Dunia, Sami, Ernesto, Ara, Ren, Aubrey, Gabby, Bruno, Oliwia. Coaches: James, Julia, Bowie, Zoey, Millie, Thom. Host: Chris, Chef.]

[A military compound built on the beach. Obstacle walls. A mess tent. A flagpole with a bell at the top.]

Chris: Welcome to BASIC STRAINING! Chef's boot camp. Five phases. Last tribe standing wins immunity.

[SCENE: Challenge compound — canoe hold — Phase 1.] [Present: Natalia, Manu, Nura, Grett, Lake, Spencer, Dunia, Sami, Ernesto, Ara, Ren, Aubrey, Gabby, Bruno, Oliwia. Host: Chef.]

[Fifteen contestants holding wooden canoes over their heads. Arms locked straight. Chef pacing between the rows like a predator.]

Chef: This canoe represents your COMMITMENT!

[SCENE: Challenge compound — mess tent — Phase 2.] [Present: Natalia, Manu, Nura, Grett, Lake, Spencer, Dunia, Sami, Ernesto, Ara, Ren, Aubrey, Gabby, Bruno, Oliwia. Host: Chef.]

[Nura tries to finish. Gets halfway through. Her fork stops. She sets it down.]

Chef: DONE?

Nura: [looking at the tray, then at Chef, with the most deadpan expression of the season] Chef. I will not eat whatever this is.

Chef: DISMISSED!

[Nura walks to the bench with her head high. She sits. She does not look back at the food.]

[Ren can't finish either. They push their tray away with both hands.]

Ren: I think it pushed back.

Chef: DISMISSED!

[SCENE: Challenge compound — water station — between phases.] [Present: Natalia, Gabby, Sami. Background: all remaining contestants and dismissed players milling around the compound.]

Gabby: That was the worst thing I've ever eaten.

[Sami appears. Casual. He fills a water cup. Turns to Natalia.]

Sami: Hey. Random question. How many final-two deals do you have right now?

[SCENE: Challenge compound — open area — Phase 3: Dance Drill.] [Present: Natalia, Manu, Grett, Lake, Spencer, Dunia, Sami, Ernesto, Ara, Aubrey, Oliwia. Host: Chef.]

[Oliwia trips over her own feet. Just — walks into her own shoe. Falls. Gets up. Falls again.]

Chef: ...DISMISSED. Are you okay?

Oliwia: [on the ground] I'm fine. The ground is fine. We're all fine.

[SCENE: Challenge compound — obstacle course — Phase 4.] [Present: Natalia, Manu, Grett, Lake, Spencer, Sami, Ara, Aubrey. Host: Chef.]

[Natalia hits the wall climb. Her tweaked knee from Episode 5 — the one she's been hiding — buckles. She grabs the rope. Hangs. Her face goes white.]

[She lets go. Drops to the ground. Walks to the bell. Looks at it for a long time.]

[Rings it.]

[Manu watches from the rope climb. He's halfway up. His grip is fine. He looks at Natalia on the bench. He looks at the bell.]

[He drops. Walks to the bell. Rings it.]

[SCENE: Challenge compound — forest trail — Phase 5: Night March.] [Present: Grett, Lake, Spencer, Sami, Ara, Aubrey. Host: Chef.]

[Full dark. Stars. The remaining six march in formation through a forest trail. Chef leading with a lantern.]

[Grett breaks formation. She walks to the bell. Her hand rests on the rope for a long time. Then she pulls it.]

Sami: [barely audible] Not bad.

Spencer: [barely audible] I know.

Chris: BLUE WINS IMMUNITY! Red — safe! Green — tribal council tonight. But first — Blue, you send someone from Green to Exile.

Bowie: Agreed.

[SCENE: Blue camp — water's edge — evening.] [Present: Lake, Sami.]

Lake: I rang the bell tonight.

[SCENE: Tribal council — night.] [Present: Natalia, Manu, Nura, Grett. Coaches: James, Julia. Host: Chris.]

Chris: Time to vote.

[VOTING.]

[Natalia walks to the urn. Pauses. Writes JAMES.]

[Manu writes JULIA.]

[Nura writes NATALIA.]

[Grett writes JAMES.]

Chris: The card is not activated. I'll read the votes.

Chris: First vote — James.

Chris: Julia.

Chris: Natalia.

Chris: Last vote...

Chris: James.

Chris: Two votes James. One vote Julia. One vote Natalia. James — that's enough. Bring me your torch.

Chris: James. The tribe has spoken.

[He snuffs the torch. Smoke curls.]

[SCENE: Redemption Island — dawn.] [Present: Finn.]

[Finn's shelter. Eleven marks carved on the wall with a shell edge.]

Chris: [to camera] Grett's calling the shots on Green — but she broke her own bloc to do it.

[He grins.]

Chris: This is Total Drama: Coaches vs New Blood.

[FADE TO BLACK.]

END OF EPISODE 6 — "BASIC STRAINING"
